sentences.text: Black Alder is pollinated by wind.
In Mainz-Bingen, it has been reported throughout the year, with sightings peaking in December.
The European goldfinch and the Musk beetle are recorded as predators of Black Alder.
It is recorded as a host of Turkeytail, Tinder Bracket, the Dotted border, Red-Belted Bracket, the Lime Hawk-Moth, and Candlesnuff Fungus.
